title: In silico identification, high yielding isolation and in vitro validation of 6beta-cinnamoyl-7beta -hydroxyvouacapen - 5alpha - ol as a Wnt/beta-catenin pathway targeted anti-cancer secondary metabolite of Caesalpinia pulcherrima.
authors: Seneviratne, Nirwani N; Saliu, Tolulope P; Muhinudeen, Fathima T; Gamage, Sanadie D; Garusinghe, Prabudhi S; Chathuranga, Damith; Athukorala, Vinoda D; Kothalawala, Ashein; Jayasekara, Asirini H; Rathnayaka, Rajitha K; De Silva, Umanda Anjalee; Faries, Mohamed; Weragoda, Thimali H; Wijerathne, Shalini K; Rajagopalan, Umapriyatharshini; Senathilake, Kanishka S; Tennekoon, Kamani H; Adhikari, Achyut; Samarakoon, Sameera R
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接、MD和MM-PBSA筛选植物代谢物抑制β-catenin-Tcf/Lef蛋白-蛋白互作，虽涉及蛋白-DNA相关通路但非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway is frequently dysregulated in cancer stem cells (CSCs), a sub population of cancer cell mass that drives tumor proliferation, metastasis, recurrence, and chemoresistance. Despite its therapeutic significance, no clinically approved drugs specifically target this pathway. In the present study, secondary metabolites of the medicinal plant Caesalpinia pulcherrima was computationally screened by molecular docking, dynamics simulation and Molecular Mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann Surface Area (MM-PBSA) based free energy calculations to identify potential inhibitors of beta-catenin-Tcf/Lef interaction, a key downstream event essential for Wnt/beta-catenin signaling. Diterpene metabolite 6beta-Cinnamoyl-7beta-hydroxyvouacapen-5alpha-ol (6betaCHV) was identified as a potent inhibitor of the pathway along with four previously reported Wnt/beta-catenin pathway inhibitors. To validate the results, bioactivity-guided isolation of major active compound was performed using NTERA-2 cells as a cancer stem cell (CSC) model. The isolated compound was spectroscopically characterized and confirmed to be 6betaCHV. Anti-proliferative activity assays revealed that 6betaCHV suppressed proliferation of breast cancer stem cells (bCSCs) (IC(5)(0) = 49.18 microM), NTERA-2 cells (IC(5)(0) = 8.92 microM), and highly Wnt-dependent cancer types, including gastric adenocarcinoma (IC(5)(0) = 1.90 microM), hepatocellular carcinoma (IC(5)(0) = 5.96 microM), and ovarian carcinoma (IC(5)(0) = 7.66 microM). 6betaCHV upregulated the tumor suppressor gene, p53 while downregulating Wnt target genes, Cyclin D1 and CD44 leading to apoptosis in bCSCs as confirmed by Caspase 3/7 activation. These findings establish 6betaCHV as the principal anticancer compound in C. pulcherrima, exerting its effects, at least in part, through Wnt/beta-catenin pathway inhibition.
abstract_zh: Wnt/beta-catenin信号通路在癌症干细胞（CSCs）中经常失调，CSCs是癌细胞团中的一个亚群，驱动肿瘤增殖、转移、复发和化疗耐药。尽管其具有治疗意义，但目前尚无临床批准的药物专门靶向该通路。在本研究中，通过分子对接、动力学模拟和基于分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM-PBSA）的自由能计算，对药用植物金凤花（Caesalpinia pulcherrima）的次级代谢产物进行了计算筛选，以识别beta-catenin-Tcf/Lef相互作用的潜在抑制剂，该相互作用是Wnt/beta-catenin信号传导所必需的关键下游事件。二萜代谢物6beta-Cinnamoyl-7beta-hydroxyvouacapen-5alpha-ol（6betaCHV）被鉴定为该通路的强效抑制剂，同时还有四种先前报道的Wnt/beta-catenin通路抑制剂。为验证结果，使用NTERA-2细胞作为癌症干细胞（CSC）模型，进行了生物活性引导的主要活性化合物分离。分离出的化合物经光谱表征确认其为6betaCHV。抗增殖活性测定显示，6betaCHV抑制了乳腺癌干细胞（bCSCs）的增殖（IC(5)(0) = 49.18微摩尔），NTERA-2细胞（IC(5)(0) = 8.92微摩尔），以及高度依赖Wnt的癌症类型，包括胃腺癌（IC(5)(0) = 1.90微摩尔）、肝细胞癌（IC(5)(0) = 5.96微摩尔）和卵巢癌（IC(5)(0) = 7.66微摩尔）。6betaCHV上调了肿瘤抑制基因p53，同时下调Wnt靶基因Cyclin D1和CD44，导致bCSCs凋亡，这通过Caspase 3/7激活得到确认。这些发现确立了6betaCHV是金凤花中的主要抗癌化合物，其作用至少部分通过抑制Wnt/beta-catenin通路实现。
